about: SMB Hub is the community from CanadianSME where small business owners and entrepreneurs connect and trade experience, tools and advice, from financing to expansion.
Connect with people running businesses like yours, in your city or your industry.
Post a question, share a win or pass on a lesson. Filter the feed to find what you need.
Smaller rooms for specific topics: funding, retail, importing, AI and more.
List your company in the business directory and share offers with members.
SMB Hub is operated by Cmarketing Inc., the company behind CanadianSME Small Business Magazine, the Small Business Expo, the Small Business Summit and the Small Business Awards.
help: Quick answers about accounts, posting, privacy, connections and plans. Still stuck? Email the team and we will help.
Do I need an account to look around?
No. Anyone can read the public feed and browse members, groups and businesses. You need a free account to post, like, comment and connect.
Open Home, click the box at the top of the feed, choose what you are sharing (question, win, offer, hiring or intro), write it and press Post. You can add one photo.
You choose each time: anyone, members only, your connections, or only you. Posts inside a private group are visible to that group’s members.
Press Connect on a member’s card or profile. They get an alert and can accept or decline.
Use the three dots on any post that is not yours and choose Report. Our team reviews every report.
How does the AI assistant work?
Ask the Hub answers from member posts, advisors and CanadianSME articles, and points you to members who can help. Free members get 10 questions a month.
How do I upgrade my plan?
See Membership plans for what each plan includes, then contact us and we will set it up.

guidelines: policy
Policies and help
Community guidelines
SMB Hub works when members treat each other with respect and share what they know. These guidelines apply to posts, comments, groups, messages and business listings.
h
What we value
ul
Respect. Disagree with ideas, never attack people.
Collaboration. Share knowledge and contacts generously.
Professionalism. Keep it relevant and free of offensive language.
Integrity. Be honest about who you are and what your business does.
Growth. Stay open to feedback and help others improve.
h
Please do
ul
Welcome newcomers, including people with less experience or funding than you.
Post with a purpose: to inform, to ask or to share a lesson.
Write clearly. Tone is hard to read online.
Give feedback that helps the other person improve.
Celebrate other members’ wins and support them when times are hard.
Review the advisors, events and resources you have used.
h
Please don’t
ul
Spam, including the same comment pasted across groups or unsolicited sales messages.
Harass, bully, intimidate or stalk anyone.
Post hate speech about race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, disability or any similar trait.
Pretend to be someone else or misstate who you work for.
Share another person’s personal or confidential information without consent.
Post personal email addresses or phone numbers. Use messaging instead.
Share copyrighted material you have no right to share.
Post external crowdfunding links. They will be removed.
Promote illegal activity, violence or terrorism.
Try to break the site: no hacking, viruses or harmful files.
h
How we enforce this
p

Our team may review content. Depending on how serious the problem is, we may remove a post, send a warning, suspend an account or remove a member for good. This list is not complete, and we may act on other behaviour that harms the community.
h
Report a problem
p
Use Report in the menu on any post, or email support@smehub.ca with a link or screenshot. Reports are reviewed by our team.
h
Changes
p
We may update these guidelines. Continuing to use SMB Hub means you accept the current version.

We review this policy regularly and tell members promptly when it changes.
